$comment: Manual route reassignments, keyed by the lowercase comparison key. Use sparingly: a route override that is needed often means the classifier rule should be fixed instead. Every entry must record why the automated assignment was wrong.

rationale.roblox tax: The marketplace fee is a separate product from DevEx and owns its own calculator route.
rationale.tax roblox: Word-order variant of the same marketplace fee intent.
rationale.how to convert robux to usd: Phrased as a process question rather than a conversion, so the cash-out guide serves it better than the converter.
rationale.sell robux to usd: Process intent. The guide also carries the warning against unofficial selling services.
rationale.turn robux into money: Process intent rather than an arithmetic conversion.
